limitations: This is a bounded 12-image sample: first, middle, and last available rows were selected from each of the four shards. It is not full independent validation of all 928 available images or all candidate rows.
The batch validation.json lists repeated_observations as an empty array; no repeated-category descriptions were highlighted there to add to this sample.

All 12 sampled candidates have null difficulty_hypothesis and strategy_hypothesis; no image-specific hypotheses were present to assess. No difficulty, success-rate, or optimal-strategy conclusions were inferred.

Geometry taxonomy is used as candidate vocabulary only. Connectivity can remain uncertain where a static image does not establish whether an apparent blocker is an impassable play boundary; labels in candidate shards remain unchanged and unaccepted.
